subject: [Encord] Coffee in Austin with founding team?
text:

been working with RetailTech teams like Standard AI, Focal Systems, and

recognition, inventory management, autonomous checkout, and customer

subject: Re: Leadership in Austin 19th/20th of Nov
text:

Noticed you're based in Austin - some of our leadership team will be
visiting to visit customers on the 19-20 Nov. They'd love to drop by for a
quick coffee or on-site chat if you're around.

For context, we spoke with Andres Milioto earlier in the year about
Encord's work supporting drone and robotics teams like Skydio and Zipline

Would you be open to meeting while we're in town?

subject: Encord <> Flash
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congratulations on the role at Flash. Was wondering if we will see you at NeurIPS this year.

Are you available for a quick virtual coffee in the coming weeks? We've been following Flash for a while now, as we're seeing a lot of momentum in the smart city space (working with the likes of Metropolis, Automotus, etc.). 

Not sure if your team has any plans to reevaluate their data infra stack this year? Either way, it would be great to introduce ourselves and get your feedback on what we're building.

Encord is an SF-based AI data infrastructure platform (raised a $30M Series B last year) built to help AI teams get better models to market faster. 200+ of the world's top AI teams are using Encord to:

• 
Curate, manage, and clean unstructured training data at scale

• 
Fully manage multimodal annotation with customizable, role-based workflows, integrated QA and automation, and direct access to annotation teams
When's a good time to check in?

-[SENDER]
